[b][h3]Character Introduction:[/h3][/b]
New Member - [b]Elise[/b] Appears!
As the brain of the team, she always demonstrates crucial strategic abilities in battles and is a trusted member of the team.
Besides her excellent intellect, she also possesses extremely outstanding long legs!
"Captain! Have you understood the briefing for this mission?..."
"Step on me! I mean... understood!"


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2455140/_/


[b][h3]Development Journal:[/h3][/b]
[b][We hope our game is more than just an erotic game.][/b]

This was a core idea in our early development, aiming to create a game rich in gameplay. We are dedicated to creating good game mechanics and a core experience. Therefore, during the development process, we paid special attention to the design of the core mechanics. We delved into the sources of fun in survival games and reconstructed a unique core gameplay for "Wings of Seduction."

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/38757594/7da85fbf07b97ce4b91eef251550d7342d9c4082.jpg[/img]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/38757594/17e7cdf431374048ebf3a95824297dcd6625b96a.jpg[/img]

In the process, due to continuous reflection on what players need, there were always many adjustments and modifications. We also added some systems that were not originally planned. We did all this because of the studio's belief: "Players can sense when you are not sincere." We hope to provide the best possible experience in the areas we can control.

Surprisingly, during the process, even we developers, who are most prone to getting tired of the game, still enjoy it every time we test it. This gives us more confidence to keep fighting.

Finally, after countless sleepless nights, we completed the initial full version, which contains much more content than we originally estimated. We look forward to meeting you on July 19th and letting you experience our meticulously crafted "Wings of Seduction."

Ramen Cat Studio - Lighthouse

[h1]🐎◆ Story🐎[/h1]

During the Three Kingdoms era, warlords vied for supremacy, aspiring to unify the Central Plains through strategy and warfare. Yet, amidst the continuous conflict, the long-awaited era of peace and prosperity for the common people remained elusive. The chaos of the Three Kingdoms entered its latter stage after enduring years of incessant battles.

In the year 223 AD, on his deathbed, the ailing Emperor Liu Bei entrusted me with the care of his orphaned daughter, Liu Shan, to assist her in ruling and even suggested my intervention in case of her inability to lead. However, as his most loyal advisor, I could not entertain such thoughts. My true aspiration is to groom Liu Shan into a beloved and capable Empress, fostering Shu Han into a powerful nation capable of unifying the realm. This is my life's greatest ambition.

However, nothing unfolds as easily as envisioned. Ambitious stepsons eyeing power, rebellions in the southern regions, rebellious generals, and the invasion by Cao Wei posed successive challenges upon Liu Shan's ascension…

Amidst internal strife and external threats, what choices should I make to lead Shu Han toward an era of peace and prosperity while nurturing Liu Shan to become a wise and benevolent Empress?

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/35300011/b0f6d19a744e0ea516e4d606a842c51231eb73cc.png[/img]

[h1]🌟◆ Gameplay🌟[/h1]

Players take on the role of Zhuge Liang, supporting Liu Shan's reign as the Chancellor of Shu Han, nurturing her into an exceptional Empress capable of unifying the realm during tumultuous times. They must navigate the challenges faced by the nation.

Each month in the game allows decisions on two national policies and three arrangements for Liu Shan's development. Policy decisions impact the nation's metrics while nurturing Liu Shan involves choices between "Studying," "Conversations," "Outings," and "Rest," enabling her to lead a balanced life and foster goodwill. Every decision and arrangement influences the destiny of Liu Shan and the nation.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/35300011/9113fa692d0581b5e8fe9ff786a7d21f9a9032e1.png[/img]
